5.text: The categorical assertion of Mr. Gondatti, however, that the Asiatic Eskimo

6.text: came from St. Lawrence Island, seems to me highly improbable, though I also

7.text: assume that the Asiatic Eskimo are not indigenous to the Pacific coast. Whether

8.text: they came from the Arctic coast of Asia or that of America is another question;

9.text: but, in any case, they migrated from north to south, and St. Lawrence Island

10.text: is the limit of their migrations. W. H. Dall repeats a statement of a native

11.text: of Plover Bay by the name of Nokum, who told that the “Bowhead [whale]

12.text: men” came to Asia long ago from the Islands to the northeast (the Diomedes),

13.text: and were allowed by the “Deer men” to settle on the barren, rocky coast.¹
